input.summary: Insert a new Section 20 (Indemnification) with a Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity, standard procedure, narrow Customer indemnity, and infringement remedies (curing the broken Section 20.5 cross-reference in 9.3).
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnity article at all, even though Section 9.3 relies on "the remedies required by Section 20.5" and Section 21.3 treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims, so we have inserted a new Section 20 giving us a Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, Vendor's breach of law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a reciprocal but narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law. If helpful we can accept the usual infringement exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations and specifications) as drafted in 20.4 and discuss a super-cap for the Vendor indemnity, but an IP indemnity itself is a requirement for us.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to, acquisition of, or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of content or materials Customer provides to the Services or Customer's breach of Applicable Law. Customer has no other indemnification obligation under this Agreement.

The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim, which failure to give relieves the indemnifying Party only to the extent it is materially prejudiced. The indemnifying Party shall control the defence and settlement with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate with its own counsel at its own expense. The indemnifying Party shall not settle a claim in a way that admits fault by, imposes a non-monetary obligation on, or fails to release, the indemnified Party without its prior written consent.

Vendor's obligation under Section 20.1(a) does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's unauthorized modification of the Services or a Deliverable, combination of the Services or a Deliverable with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would not have arisen but for the combination, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications.

For a claim described in Section 20.1(a), Vendor shall at its expense procure for Customer the right to continue using the affected item or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent non-infringing item. If neither remedy is commercially practicable, Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverables and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the terminated period and Fees paid for the affected Deliverables. These remedies do not limit Vendor's defence and indemnity obligations under Section 20.1.
